name: PointHacker
description: Full Stack web application focused on maximizing value on reward points from your credit card

paragraphs: A full-stack web app for maximizing the value of your credit-card reward points — compare direct portal redemptions against every transfer-partner option and see which one is actually worth the most, then log what you booked to find out what your points were really worth. Around that it lets you set an award goal ("Tokyo, business class, 2 people") and see how close your points get you, ranks your points by travel region, tracks which cards feed which program, keeps a history of every balance, warns before points expire, factors in transfer-bonus promos, and recommends which card's welcome…
Live: point-hacker.vercel.app — sign in with Google; each account only sees and manages its own cards and balances.
